using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class AofSyncTaskInfoTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncTaskAsync_LogsStartingInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, null);
            var aofTaskStoreMock = new Mock<AofTaskStore>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var garnetClientMock = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            string localNodeId = "localNode";
            string remoteNodeId = "remoteNode";
            long startAddress = 123;

            // Setup minimal required properties and methods
            garnetClientMock.SetupGet(c => c.IsConnected).Returns(true);
            garnetClientMock.Setup(c => c.Dispose());

            // Setup clusterProvider to return a dummy iterator with BulkConsumeAllAsync
            var iteratorMock = new Mock<TsavoriteLogScanSingleIterator>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            iteratorMock.Setup(i => i.BulkConsumeAllAsync(
                It.IsAny<IBulkLogEntryConsumer>(),
                It.IsAny<int>(),
                It.IsAny<int>(),
                It.IsAny<System.Threading.CancellationToken>()))
                .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var appendOnlyFileMock = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            appendOnlyFileMock.Setup(a => a.ScanSingle(startAddress, long.MaxValue, true, false, loggerMock.Object))
                .Returns(iteratorMock.Object);
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(appendOnlyFileMock.Object);

            var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            serverOptionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.ReplicaSyncDelayMs).Returns(10);

            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<ClusterManager>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var currentConfigMock = new Mock<CurrentConfig>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            currentConfigMock.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(remoteNodeId))
                .Returns(("127.0.0.1", 1234));
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(currentConfigMock.Object);

            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.storeWrapper).Returns(storeWrapperMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);

            aofTaskStoreMock.Setup(s => s.TryRemove(It.IsAny<AofSyncTaskInfo>())).Returns(true);

            var aofSyncTaskInfo = new AofSyncTaskInfo(
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                aofTaskStoreMock.Object,
                localNodeId,
                remoteNodeId,
                garnetClientMock.Object,
                startAddress,
                loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            await aofSyncTaskInfo.ReplicaSyncTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Starting ReplicationManager.ReplicaSyncTask")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AofSync task terminated; client disposed")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Dummy classes to satisfy dependencies
    internal class ClusterProvider
    {
        public StoreWrapper storeWrapper { get; }
        public ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
        public ClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
        public ClusterProvider(StoreWrapper sw, ServerOptions so, ClusterManager cm)
        {
            storeWrapper = sw;
            serverOptions = so;
            clusterManager = cm;
        }
    }

    internal class AofTaskStore
    {
        public virtual bool TryRemove(AofSyncTaskInfo task) => true;
    }

    internal class GarnetClientSession : IDisposable
    {
        public virtual bool IsConnected => true;
        public virtual void Connect() { }
        public virtual void Dispose() { }
    }

    internal interface IBulkLogEntryConsumer { }

    internal class TsavoriteLogScanSingleIterator : IDisposable
    {
        public virtual Task BulkConsumeAllAsync(IBulkLogEntryConsumer consumer, int delayMs, int maxChunkSize, System.Threading.CancellationToken token) => Task.CompletedTask;
        public virtual void Dispose() { }
    }

    internal class StoreWrapper
    {
        public AppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile { get; }
    }

    internal class AppendOnlyFile
    {
        public virtual TsavoriteLogScanSingleIterator ScanSingle(long start, long end, bool scanUncommitted, bool recover, ILogger logger) => null;
    }

    internal class ServerOptions
    {
        public int ReplicaSyncDelayMs { get; }
    }

    internal class ClusterManager
    {
        public CurrentConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
    }

    internal class CurrentConfig
    {
        public virtual (string, int) GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(string nodeId) => ("", 0);
    }
}
